description:
Secure file server for Windows

CompleteFTP is a high performance Windows file server supporting secure file transfer via FTPS (FTP over SSL), SFTP (FTP over SSH), HTTP, HTTPS, SCP and SSH. CompleteFTP also supports web applications written in Javascript, and collaborative file sharing.
- Improve SFTP and FTPS performance and memory utilisation.
- Added support for MLSD and MLST FTP commands.
- Ensure in TLS the entire certificate chain is loaded and sent to the client.
- Upgrade log4net assembly to 3.3.2.
- Added password confirmation when generating a CSR private key; switched from PVK to PEM format.
- Fix clustering issue where triggers and email notifications added to the primary server weren't synched to the secondaries.
- CompleteBox now shows more detailed error messages for failed connections, file transfers, and permission-denied errors.
- Web File Manager now shows the correct "Disk quota exceeded" error instead of "Not logged in" when a user's quota is exceeded during upload.
- Fixed a typo in the SAML configuration editor that prevented the IDP User Matching checkbox from rendering or functioning.
- Fixed an internal server error that occurred when using IDP-initiated SSO.
- Fixed FM4 Change Password option doing nothing when right-clicking a password-protected shared file.
- Fixed FM4 showing a redundant login prompt after successful login when site file-sharing is disabled.
- Improve FM4 performance for large folder listings.
- Fixed an issue in FM4 where the Change Password dialog did not appear for password-protected shared folders/files.
- Renamed "Remove Share" to "Delete Share" in the confirmation dialog for consistency.
- Fixed a regression in Program trigger argument-building where arguments containing commas were split incorrectly on the command line.
- Make the initial sending of the SSH version asynchronous to improve connection performance.
